method: native-image-reviewed partial body and upper columns; marching cubes 0.5; no resampling, smoothing or filling
scope: Partial fornix body, anterior transition and upper-column interior, with native40 Z745-650 review. Scope cuts are not established anatomical boundaries. Lower columns, crura, fimbria and continuity to the mammillary body remain incomplete. Two medial cleft-edge voxels were excluded. Not expert-reviewed.
